focus_failure: CAMERA_VERIFICATION_FAILED: client focus failed after the Minecraft client joined and before startspec.
root_cause: The GLFW client published its title through _NET_WM_NAME but no legacy WM_NAME. The inherited xdotool --name search therefore returned no window even though the exact Minecraft client window was visible, active, and focusable through Openbox.
repair: Discover one visible exact Minecraft 1.16.5 WM_CLASS window; validate its title prefix, KnotClient PID/gameDir, 640x360 geometry, activation, active-window ID, and input-focus ID with bounded readiness polling. Then require the pinned FOV receipt and fixed-camera server marker.
camera_input_validity: Strengthened: the pre-start gate now binds the exact client process/render window and dimensions, retains verified X input focus, and fails closed on FOV or fixed-camera drift.

focused_tests.command: qualified operator environment python -m pytest -q tests/test_regime_a_client_focus.py tests/test_regime_a_a4_runner.py
